shortDescription: Ladbrokes owner Entain LSE:ENT reported a 2% rise in third-quarter net gaming revenue and reiterated its annual forecast on Thursday, as a strong showing in the UK and Ireland offset the impact from weaker performance in Brazil.Here are some details:($1 = 0.7556 pounds)

children: reported a 2% rise in third-quarter net gaming revenue and reiterated its annual forecast on Thursday, as a strong showing in the UK and Ireland offset the impact from weaker performance in Brazil.
Brazil banned online gambling last month, piling pressure on an industry already squeezed by high costs and regulatory scrutiny

Entain, which was already facing a tough environment in Brazil due to increased competition, had warned its 2026 group underlying core profit would be at the lower end of its earlier forecast range of £910 million to £960 million
The company reported net gaming revenue growth of 2% and online revenue growth of 3% for the three months to September 30
UK & Ireland net gaming revenue rose 8%, with online sales growth of 14% beating the company's own expectations
Entain stuck to the full-year 2026 forecast it provided late last month, and affirmed its target of £500 million ($661.7 million) in annual adjusted cash flow in 2028
